nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

400.description: invalid-limit, invalid-cursor, unknown-query-parameter (a query parameter the collection does not declare, including the retired after, from, offset and nextToken), or malformed-request-query.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared not-found, illegal-transition, concurrent-update and validation-failed, or one of this context's, e.g. stale-profile-revision.
